news.title: Americans’ use of social media for health information differs by race and ethnicity
news.summary_en: Hispanic, Black, and Asian adults are more likely than White adults to get health information from social media and turn to health and wellness influencers.

news.title: India and Pakistan: Rivals With Divergent Views of the Global Order
news.summary_en: Indians and Pakistanis tend to name the other country as their top threat, and each side doubts the other’s commitment to good relations.

news.title: Public opinion of India is mixed across 36 countries
news.summary_en: Public opinion of India ranges widely across 36 countries, with favorable views ranging from 79% in Sri Lanka to 7% in Pakistan.

news.title: Second Trump administration has ended Temporary Protected Status for most immigrants who had it
news.summary_en: The second Trump administration has ended Temporary Protected Status for 13 countries, affecting roughly 1 million recipients.

news.title: Most U.S. adults have lived with a romantic partner they’re not married to by their early 40s
news.summary_en: Around three-quarters of Americans in their late 30s or early 40s have lived with a romantic partner they’re not married to at some point in their lives.

news.title: Most Americans are uncomfortable with transgender athletes on sports teams that don’t match their birth sex
news.summary_en: Most Americans are not comfortable with transgender athletes competing on teams that don’t match their birth sex.
